what: three readers vs radiologist labels on radiologist_val (200 frontal images)
status: MEASUREMENT ONLY -- the frozen v2 modeled and eval-only sets are unchanged
gate_for_reference: radiologist_val AUC >= 0.85 and 95% bootstrap CI lower bound >= 0.80
bootstrap: 2000 resamples, percentile CI, seed 7, identical procedure for every reader

readers.xrv_densenet121_res224_all: TorchXRayVision densenet121-res224-all. NOT independent of CheXpert: its training mix includes CheXpert, so it partly learned these report labels. No Support Devices output at all. Scored from valid_xrv_probs.npy, subset to the same 200.
readers.chexzero_zeroshot_ensemble: CheXzero (rajpurkarlab/CheXzero), zero-shot, 10-checkpoint ensemble, prompt pair ('{}','no {}'). Trained on MIMIC-CXR report TEXT, not on CheXpert and not on any label column -- the most independent reader here. Gate on its five competition pathologies: mean AUC 0.8672, min 0.7845, so the pipeline is sound. Input deviation: scored on radiologist_val_224.npy (resize-short-side-224 + 224 centre crop), not CheXzero's letterbox-to-320-then-224. The source JPEGs are gone with the deleted archive. Identical pixels to this project's own classifier, so the comparison is controlled on input.
readers.ours_best_ckpt_10head: the FROZEN v2 predictor. Unchanged, sha256 verified.
readers.ours_11head_measurement: same architecture, recipe, split and seed, with an 11th binary head for enlarged_cardiomediastinum. Trained for this measurement; NOT part of the protocol. Trunk disturbance vs best.ckpt: mean |delta| 0.0097, max 0.0442, so the ten shared heads barely moved and the new head's number is comparable.

support_devices_error_breakdown.answer: 35 of 52 errors (67%) are false negatives -- device present, predicted absent -- at the protocol's Youden threshold; 39 of 51 (76%) at 0.5. The head is under-sensitive, not over-eager.
support_devices_error_breakdown.plumbing_check: report_vs_radiologist_disagree is 0 by construction -- radiologist_val's label column IS valid.csv's radiologist label, so this only confirms the label join is correct; it measures no noise.
